The '''Noetikon of Light''' was a treasured [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by the time of the [[Great Galactic War]]. It was one of a number of [[Noetikon]]s, [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]]-style devices that were imprinted with the knowledge, wisdom and personality of the greatest [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] in the Order. The artifact contained the personalities of Jedi Masters [[Noab Hulis]], [[Wole Vahn]], and [[Nomi Sunrider]].

It was stored in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] until the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], the temple was destroyed and the Noetikons were lost. The artifact was obtained by members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and surgically implanted into an [[Unidentified Black Sun smuggler|unknown smuggler]] affiliated with the crime syndicate. It was discovered by a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] while on a mission to cure [[Yuon Par]] of a mysterious illness. After a brief consultation, the three masters were unable to think of a cure for the illness and recommended that the Jedi Consular and [[Qyzen Fess]] pursue the [[Noetikon of Secrets]].
